title: Calling Lightning to Slay Holy Sons
summary: Kidnappers holding Liu Yiyi summon Ye Fan alone to Blazing Devil Mountain in the central Eastern Wasteland, once home of the Fire clan's divine spirit that the Ruthless Emperor killed. Remembering Yiyi as someone from Earth like him, he goes alone, but Hei Huang follows him through the Myriad Formation Gate, which disables the Holy Body's vision. There the thirteen-member Holy Body Killing Alliance waits, among them the Wanchu Holy Maiden Zhao Yanran, Jin Chixiao of the Northern Plains' Huangjin family, Xiang Yime of the Xing Dynasty and Li Rui, the Yaoguang Holy Son candidate, along with great-power elders. Ye Fan offers them the cauldron to sow discord, then deliberately sets off his own heavenly tribulation and drags them all into it; the chain reaction kills the holy sons and elders, and he emerges at Four Poles Great Perfection. Soon after, word comes that a Holy Lord-level Yin-Yang Sect expert has broken into the oasis and taken Nannan, demanding that Ye Fan come to Yaochi, and he goes.
